description: Template for recording revision actions on needs_revision records. One file per record.

record_id.description: Unique record identifier matching the review decision file

original_issue.description: The reviewer's stated reason for needs_revision decision

proposed_fix.description: Description of what fix was applied and why

revision_notes.description: Additional context, rationale, or reviewer comments about the revision

resolver_id.description: Identity of the person or tool that performed the revision

status.description: Current status in the revision lifecycle

provenance_blocker.description: Whether a provenance/lineage issue blocks content revision

provenance_notes.description: Details of provenance resolution, if applicable

second_reviewer_id.description: Identity of the second human reviewer (populated after re-evaluation)

second_reviewer_decision.description: Decision from the second human review (populated after re-evaluation)

second_reviewer_reason.description: Rationale for the second review decision
